svg.aria-label: Left top: the histogram of the gray image has 4 bars of 16 pixels at levels 96, 112, 120 and 144. Left bottom: a table with level, count, cumulative count c(v) and new level: 96, 16, 16, 0; 112, 16, 32, 85; 120, 16, 48, 170; 144, 16, 64, 255. new(112) = round((32 - 16) times 255 / (64 - 16)) = 85. Right: the equalized image: rows 0 and 1 are 255, rows 2 to 5 are 85 85 170 170 170 170 85 85, rows 6 and 7 are 0.
